name: Closed-Form Volume Rendering with Gaussian Transfer Functions
aliases: Analytically integrated segment with Gaussian TF
Closed-Form Approximation to the Volume Rendering Integral with Gaussian Transfer Functions
definition: A volume rendering technique where the transfer function is modeled as a multivariate Gaussian primitive, allowing the volume rendering integral over a line segment to be solved analytically in closed form, assuming linear variation of data values between sampled points.
summary: Closed-Form Volume Rendering with Gaussian Transfer Functions computes the emission-absorption integral analytically using the error function, eliminating sampling errors inherent in numerical methods.
